claim_evidence.claim_text: The pinned repository composes SDK, tools, workspace, and agent-server packages; Conversation selects local or remote execution, while remote execution ultimately reconstructs and runs a LocalConversation on the server.
claim_evidence.confidence: high for v1.35.0; remote backend and hosted deployment internals were only surveyed

claim_evidence.claim_text: ConversationState keeps mutable metadata and an append-only tree event log separately from an active-branch, condensation-aware View containing only model-convertible events; persistence, replay, navigation, and view rebuilding preserve that distinction.
claim_evidence.artifact_location: Durable state, active view, branching, and condensation
claim_evidence.confidence: high for the pinned local implementation; durability requires file-backed persistence

claim_evidence.claim_text: Lifecycle control is nested: LocalConversation owns ingress, status, run/step, pause, interrupt, limits, and cancellation, while the agent server adds leases, atomic background-run ownership, concurrency bounds, event publication, rerun handling, and crash restoration.
claim_evidence.confidence: high for traced paths; ACP-specific internals and all endpoints were not analyzed

claim_evidence.claim_text: A frozen agent configuration separates model and prompt policy from durable conversation state, while initialization and each call materialize runtime tools, skills, plugins, system instructions, active view, and call context; explicit plugins are pinned but ambient plugins can be rediscovered unpinned on resume.
claim_evidence.artifact_location: Model policy, active context, and capabilities
claim_evidence.confidence: high for mechanics; exact deployed context remains configuration- and external-plugin-dependent

claim_evidence.claim_text: The normal loop is model-directed over actions, while deterministic code owns pending-action completion, sampling boundaries, dispatch, confirmation, budgets, recovery, and status; assistant content or a FinishAction can finish an ordinary run without independent task acceptance.
claim_evidence.artifact_location: The step loop and stopping semantics
claim_evidence.confidence: high for the ordinary configured path; stop hooks, critics, goal mode, and custom agents may alter behavior

claim_evidence.claim_text: Model tool calls are normalized and validated into typed actions, may pass through risk analysis, confirmation and synchronous blocking pre-hooks, execute through a runtime tool, and return typed model-visible observations or errors; async pre-hooks cannot block, post-hooks cannot undo effects, and direct execute_tool intentionally bypasses loop authorization safeguards.
claim_evidence.confidence: high for mechanics; custom executors and async hooks remain inside the caller or plugin trust boundary

claim_evidence.claim_text: Tool concurrency defaults to one; when raised, calls share conversation and workspace state and rely on declared resource keys, tool-wide fallback locks, or an explicit no-lock declaration for safe scheduling.
claim_evidence.confidence: high for scheduler policy; no outcome or race-frequency experiment was run

claim_evidence.claim_text: LocalWorkspace executes directly on the host; containment is optional and supplied by remote or container workspace deployment rather than by the local agent loop itself.
claim_evidence.confidence: high for local behavior and supported boundary; container-security effectiveness was not assessed

claim_evidence.claim_text: Condensation is optional on AgentBase; the direct README quick start has none, while get_default_agent installs an LLM summarizer that keeps a prefix and suffix, records forgotten event IDs and summary, and distinguishes hard token or request pressure from soft event-count pressure.
claim_evidence.artifact_location: Durable state, active view, branching, and condensation
claim_evidence.confidence: high for configured behavior; semantic retention and task effects are not established by implementation

claim_evidence.claim_text: Optional delegation is implemented as a tool that spawns separate local conversations, shares the parent workspace path, runs child tasks concurrently, inherits or overrides confirmation policy, aggregates final text, and rolls child usage into parent metrics.
claim_evidence.confidence: high for the inspected delegate tool; it is not default core scheduling and does not provide independent environment isolation or acceptance

claim_evidence.claim_text: Recovery and lifecycle integrity are major engineering concerns in the pinned design: unmatched-action repair, view enforcement, stuck detection, leases, and targeted pre-release fixes address concrete failures, but this evidence does not measure incidence or task correctness.
claim_evidence.artifact_location: Verification, recovery, observability, and evaluation; What history reveals
claim_evidence.confidence: moderate; concrete defects and mechanisms are verified, while relative engineering priority and generality are inferred

claim_evidence.claim_text: Independent task checking is optional: the critic defaults to absent and fails open on evaluator exceptions, while goal mode is a separate transcript-judge loop whose parse failure conservatively continues; neither governs ordinary Conversation.run by default.
claim_evidence.confidence: high for default and configured mechanics; judge accuracy and real-world benefit are unmeasured here

claim_evidence.claim_text: The bounded implementation records events, model completions, token and cost metrics, stats, traces, and server streams, but no inspected mechanism converts cross-run outcomes into automatic prompt, tool, routing, or policy optimization.
claim_evidence.confidence: high for present observability and bounded absence in the selected path; downstream or private adaptation remains unknowable

claim_evidence.claim_text: The OpenHands SDK technical report reports a 61 percent lower system-attributable error rate for V1 versus V0 during a 15-day parallel rollout and low event-log persistence and replay overhead on 39,870 events; these results support the redesign as a bundle, not any single mechanism or this tag in isolation.
claim_evidence.confidence: moderate-high for the reported protocol and numbers; author-produced comparison, bundled redesign, and version-family limits constrain causal transfer

claim_evidence.claim_text: Existing evidence qualifies rather than validates OpenHands optional summarization and judge layers: recent compaction preprints report loss, latency, or variance under other protocols, Kamoi et al. favor reliable external feedback over ungrounded intrinsic correction, and production evaluation guidance separates trajectory from outcome grading.
claim_evidence.confidence: moderate-low to moderate transfer confidence; none directly evaluates OpenHands v1.35.0 condenser, critic, or goal judge

claim_evidence.claim_text: Across Pi and OpenHands, lifecycle scale, R2/R3/R5 coupling, R5/R6 output shaping, and cross-cutting extensions recur; OpenHands additionally suggests that R9 needs an explicit distinction between runtime integrity and recovery versus task-success verification.
claim_evidence.confidence: low until more cases test counterexamples; this is taxonomy friction, not an approved revision

claim_evidence.claim_text: SWE-agent's historical experiments report that agent-computer interface choices and associated ablations affected coding outcomes, supporting the relevance of action and observation design without validating OpenHands's exact typed interface or current-model behavior.
claim_evidence.confidence: moderate transfer confidence across different implementations, models, benchmarks, and dates
